decisions: empty is aggregate-only; supported no-op functions return available with a complete minimal CFG
sourceVersion is an opaque per-function indexed snapshot token
affected-file replacement is atomic and uses explicit deleted tombstones rather than symbol-node cascades
caller cancellation writes no partial state and creates no failure marker
stable reason codes use a closed snake_case machine enum
all available CFGs have exact entry and exit blocks plus a closed edge-kind set
all modeled exits route through lexical finally and an abrupt finally transfer supersedes the queued transfer
break and continue use statically resolved intra-function targets
Python match cases are ordered predicates and guards use normal expression flow
every separate CFG has a deterministic function ID, including Python lambdas

paging defaults to 100, clamps to 500, and pages blocks and edges independently
block and edge ordering is deterministic and normative
expected CLI CFG states exit zero while failures that prevent a valid result exit nonzero
